Troubleshooting

PRELIMINARY CHECK
• Check cold tire inflation pressure.
• Check lubrication of suspension and steering linkage.
• Check chassis ground clearance and wheel alignment.
• Check battery voltage above 12 volts.
• Check that all connector are secure.
